data.exact_reserve_text: Estimate of cumulative claims incurred for 2020 underwriting year: Current estimate 334.5, One year later 360.2. * Gross and net technical items are the same.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 25.7 million in 2022, representing 25.12% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development and IBNR recalibration, as the ultimate cost of claims became more certain and prudential margins were reduced for the 2020 underwriting year. All premiums are from reinsurance acceptances.
raw_causal_phrases: projecting from past experience of the development of claims over time
ultimate cost of claims becomes more certain
relative level of margin maintained should decrease
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, as no explicit prior year movement note was found. The report states that gross and net technical items are the same, simplifying the interpretation of the triangle as gross. The named events listed on page 9 are hypothetical and do not represent actual losses impacting reserves.
